visualCharacteristics: Grid of feature items on a dark background. Each item has a 3D/graphic icon on top, a bold title, and a short description, all left-aligned. Typically four across on desktop.
contentPattern: First row labels the block ('Cards'). Each item is one row with two cells: cell 1 = icon image, cell 2 = title (heading) + description.
usage: 'Built for the experience economy' style icon-led feature grid.
